input.subject: Reminder: garden door repair – Flat 17, 113 Juniper Mews (ref R/PM016-1)
input.body:
Dear Landlord,

Following up on our email of 11 October about Flat 17, 113 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ8 6ZZ (ref R/PM016-1).

The tenant has reported that the back/garden door is stiff to close, creaking, and the hinges look misaligned. We suggest sending one of our contractors to adjust the hinges and fix it on the visit if it is a simple job, or give you a quote first if more work is needed. We don't yet have a cost estimate.

Please reply APPROVE for us to send a contractor on that basis, or let us know if you would rather deal with it yourself.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team

Dear Harriet,

Thank you for reporting the back/garden door at Flat 17, 113 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ8 6ZZ (ref R/PM016-1). We have contacted the landlord and are waiting for their go-ahead before we arrange a contractor. We will be in touch once we hear back.

One quick question: does the door still close fully and lock securely? If at any point it won't lock or secure, please tell us straight away so we can treat it as urgent.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance Team
